meta.title: Optimize code for performance and bugs
meta.body_summary: Apply React performance optimizations (useMemo, useCallback, React.memo, event listener cleanup) across multiple UI packages and add temporary optimization summary documents; documentation removed before merge.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor proposed React memoization and event cleanup; bots flagged dependency and functional issues; merged in 6h without benchmark and with some warnings unaddressed.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1709 changed lines, this is a medium-sized refactor by absolute volume, though many changes come from documentation files that were later removed. It fits a broad React performance optimization PR that was merged quickly with minor concerns raised but no blocking review.

review_details.concern_detail: Bot reviews flagged stale closures, missing dependency arrays (gantt cssVariables, handleScroll), potential overlay rendering bug in dialog-stack, and missing React keys.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce re-renders and memory usage via memoization, event listener cleanup, and CSS variable optimization across multiple React components.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: React performance optimization with hooks requires precise dependency arrays; agent missed some, causing potential stale closures and rendering bugs, highlighting boundary in React expertise.

detection_detail.code_reading: Both Copilot and CodeRabbit bots scanned the code and reported issues with missing dependencies, stale closures, and potential regressions.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance evidence provided; only narrative claims of reduced re-renders and memory improvements.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Bot-flagged issues such as stale closures in gantt and overlay bug in dialog-stack were noted but not fixed before merge.

core_change_summary.description: Applied React performance optimizations across 10 components: added useMemo/useCallback/memo to reduce re-renders, fixed memory leak in Gantt scroll listener, optimized CSS variables calculation, and corrected useState object initialization in color-picker. Also added and removed optimization documentation files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation files were added in early commits and later removed before merge, leaving no permanent docs.
change_trajectory: Initial commits: Cursor added optimization docs and summary.
Maintainer applied optimization recommendations across components (commit 6520defd).
Minor updates to gantt and calendar index.tsx after reviews.

Second Copilot review flagged missing dependencies in gantt memoization and suggested fixes for cssVariables and handleScroll.
review_signals.action_taken: No explicit commit to fix; maintainer merged after later minor tweaks.

review_signals.summary: CodeRabbit identified stale closures, missing useEffect cleanup, missing keys, and incorrect overlay behavior; no CHANGES_REQUESTED.
review_signals.action_taken: No fixes applied; merged with these issues unresolved.
